stories.question: How many rugs does your horse own?

stories.title: Which rug tonight?
stories.body: The Rug Advisor checks your local weather and clip, then suggests a day and night rug.

stories.label: Wet walk tip
stories.title: Wipe those paws
stories.body: After walks on gritted roads, wipe paws and between the pads. Grit can irritate and be licked off.
